description: Yin yoga in Coburg: deep, relaxed holding of poses for joints, fascia and calm. Classes with Susanne Müller, also online.

sections.title: Yin Yoga
sections.lead: Relax deeply, become supple, find calm.

sections.title: Yin Yoga: what to expect.
paragraphs: Keeps your body deeply supple and lets life energy flow through joints, fascia and meridian tissue. Yin yoga means holding deeply effective poses for longer in complete relaxation, for everyone who enjoys taking their practice to a higher level of mindfulness and stillness. An ideal balance for everyone whose daily life is more yang-oriented.

items.title: When and where
items.text: You can find current dates in the timetable. All classes can also be booked online.

items.title: Price
items.text: From €135 per person (10 × 60 min, from 5 participants). €150 with 3–4 participants. 10 × 90 min: €225 or €200 from 5 participants.

sections.title: Start with a trial class.
